random.description: This image shows a gross specimen of an adrenal gland. There is a well-circumscribed yellow neoplasm visible within the adrenal cortex, surrounded by normal or compressed adrenal tissue. The tumor has a characteristic golden-yellow appearance typical of an adrenal cortical adenoma or carcinoma. The surrounding soft tissues and capsule appear intact.
